overview: Belgium is a small country in Western Europe on the North Sea. Its capital, Brussels, is home to the main institutions of the European Union and the headquarters of NATO. Belgium has three official languages: Dutch, spoken mainly in Flanders in the north; French, spoken mainly in Wallonia in the south; and German, in a small area in the east. It is known for chocolate, waffles and comic books.

geography.text: Northern Belgium is low and flat, with a short, sandy North Sea coast and farmland crossed by rivers and canals. The land rises towards the south-east into the forested hills of the Ardennes. The Scheldt and the Meuse are its main rivers, and the port of Antwerp on the Scheldt is one of the largest in Europe.
